decision: Accept the exact dated articles for local source integration; production acceptance remains pending

records.determination: Count the named Dakar–Guédiawaye BRT corridor once. SunuBRT is its passenger-service identity, not a second project; stations, B1–B4 patterns and access contracts do not multiply the count. Neither the separate TER railway nor a proposed second BRT corridor is admitted by this account. No prior portfolio or historical acquisition identity is reused.

Count the named Taïba N’Diaye wind farm once, preserving PETN and spelling variants as aliases. Individual turbines and proposed expansion or storage do not add identities in this group. Its Thiès location is not annexed to the Dakar place account, and national-grid context does not prove a dedicated supply arrangement with SunuBRT. No historical acquisition docket is reused.

Count the Dakar administrative region once as a place-system account, not five additional departmental dossiers or the city alone. Its BRT project is counted separately as an infrastructure identity; PAAD, PAMUS and drainage examples do not create extra projects here. Multi-region results and the Thiès wind farm do not expand this boundary. No existing portfolio or historical acquisition identity is reused.

review_checks: Identity screening found no retained Dakar BRT, Taïba N’Diaye or Dakar administrative-region identity. Three new accounts add two projects and one place without reusing an acquisition docket; services, turbines and program components do not multiply identities.

Exact-version articles contain 566, 567 and 573 body words, eighteen sections and fifteen chronology events. Five source-bound sections and one labelled editorial evidence test per article. Historical inputs and all 34 translated readings remain intact.

Fifteen primary sources: twelve inspected HTML bodies or scoped segments, two official indexed excerpts and one extracted PDF narrative. Seven French and eight English sources; Codex author interpretation and self-review, not independent review.

Contractual fleet scope, active service patterns and actual vehicle availability remain different objects. Station solar and eventual solar traction supply do not become current charging-energy certification. The operator homepage returned 503; indexed B4 wording stays forthcoming.

The October 2025 implementation narrative is historical. Progressive operation, final handovers and a scheduled financial closing date are distinct. PDF screenshot calls produced no viewable image; no table, map or layout verification is claimed and tabular performance figures are excluded.

The separate transport-integration financing approval does not prove delivered connections or a second operating BRT line. The market notice is consultation, not award, and its URL date is not silently converted into a publication or event date.

Wind financial close, first-phase inauguration and full operation retain their distinct month/year precision. Undated annual headlines are not admitted as current measured output. Contract capacity is a power rating, not annual energy.

The original research uses 2021 operator production and modelled ERA5 wind, not a current availability series or on-site mast measurement. Quantitative chart values and ambiguous introductory unit descriptions are not imported.
Infinity's operating and development categories remain separate. MW and MWh are not interchangeable; the wind MWp source-label issue is explicit. No storage or expansion acceptance is inferred.

Supplier-reported community activities do not establish independent livelihood or consent outcomes. Work on a market does not become an accepted occupied facility. National-grid participation does not prove a dedicated supply relationship with SunuBRT.

ANSD's indexed excerpt establishes the named regional boundary. Direct PDF retrieval timed out; population tables and maps were not inspected. The five departments are not counted as five new places, and Thiès remains outside the region.
PAAD planned works and project-area toilet access do not establish completed regional sanitation or safe treatment. An assigned technical-verification role is not an actual verification result.

The water article is a pre-event preparation account, with separate October intervention dates; it is not a post-event performance audit. Selected conduits do not establish full Mamelles acceptance, and site-level checks are not universal water-supply findings.
The August flood-review publication and meeting dates remain distinct. Totals spanning other regions cannot be assigned wholly to Dakar, and construction totals are not protection guarantees.

Unavailable SENELEC and ANSD annual PDFs, unopened attachments and discovery-only sources are excluded. No live journey, account, form, map, service or browser automation was tested. Phase 60 identities and appointments are unchanged.
Production acceptance, recoverability, exact owner release, launch and thirty real operating days remain separate and unfinished.
